verdict.rationale: Mesh returns screening outcomes through an API that an automated onboarding flow can branch on. It offers synchronous screening built for real-time onboarding, a status-and-result endpoint to poll, and WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks. Results carry structured hit fields such as step_output.aml_types, alerts generated during initial screening, a configurable customer risk score, and enumerated case decisions, all backed by a downloadable OpenAPI schema. Missing for 10: documented machine-readable failure/error reason codes, a published result schema with outcome enums in the evidence, coverage beyond AML screening (e.g., document/biometric check outcomes), and independent hands-on corroboration.
